title: Law to revoke tobacco licenses for illegal cannabis sales
summary: This bill would let the city's Department of Consumer and Worker Protection refuse to renew, suspend or revoke a tobacco or e-cigarette retail dealer's license if the holder is found to have sold cannabis or cannabis products without the required state license or permit. The agency would also have to conduct outreach to inform affected licensees of this new basis for losing their license. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
